label: lem:continuous_at_interior
title: Continuity at interior points
statement: If $f$ is continuous on $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$ and $x \in (\min(a,b), \max(a,b))$, then $f$ is continuous at $x$. Since $x$ is interior, the closed interval is a neighborhood of $x$, so \texttt{ContinuousOn} upgrades to \texttt{ContinuousAt}.
proof: The closed interval is a neighborhood of $x$ (by \texttt{Icc\_mem\_nhds}), so continuity on the interval implies continuity at $x$.
